[IDSP.6.3] Primary effect, in this order:
1. Arguments arrive typed from the action adapter
   (`bridge_call`); no per-arg decode step. A NaN `Float`
   argument refuses the call with `DS_ERR_NAN_REJECTED`
   ([LEXP.4.2]).
2. The call supersedes its earlier answers ([LCRS.6.2.1]).
3. Emit `DS_EV_ACTION_CALL` with the request payload, before
   any callback ([IDSP.6.5], [IDSP.1.4]).
4. In a replay, invoke no callback ([IDSP.6.4]).
5. Look up the registered call callback. NULL →
   `DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` (the verb is a
   service request, storing a fact included, and the
   storage-unavailable category fits).
6. Construct a `ds_call_request_t { service,
   correlation, args, arg_count }`, encoding each fact
   argument as a `FactExternal` ([NCBK.6.10]), and
   invoke the typed callback. The integrator's cb does whatever the
   call needs (sync, async, deferred to a thread
   pool) and returns `ds_result_t`.
7. On cb error, propagate verbatim per IDSP.1.3.
